english_meaning: A detailed plan or route of a journey, listing places to visit and activities.
gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરીની વિગતવાર યોજના — ક્યાં જવું, ક્યારે જવું, શું કરવું તે બધું લખેલું હોય.
usage_note: Used for both business and leisure travel planning.
memory_tip: 'Itiner' sounds like 'path' in Latin — itinerary = path plan.
examples: She prepared a detailed itinerary for the Europe trip.
Our tour guide handed us the itinerary on the first day.
The itinerary included visits to three countries in five days.
Please share the itinerary so everyone knows the schedule.

english_meaning: An arrangement made in advance to secure a place, seat, or room.
gujarati_meaning: અગાઉથી જગ્યા, ઓરડો અથવા સીટ બુક કરવાની વ્યવસ્થા.
usage_note: Interchangeable with 'booking' in most travel contexts.
memory_tip: Reserve = અનામત રાખવું → reservation = અનામત.
examples: I made a reservation at the hotel three weeks in advance.
Do you have a reservation, sir?
The restaurant requires reservations on weekends.
Our flight reservation was confirmed by email.

english_meaning: An official endorsement on a passport allowing entry into a foreign country.
gujarati_meaning: પાસપોર્ટ પર સરકારી મંજૂરી — જે બીજા દેશમાં પ્રવેશ કરવાની પરવાનગી આપે છે.
usage_note: Different types: tourist visa, work visa, student visa, transit visa.
memory_tip: Visa = વિઝા — સીધો ઉધાર. Entry ticket for another country.
examples: She applied for a Schengen visa to visit France.
His visa was rejected due to incomplete documents.
You need a visa to enter the United States.
The tourist visa allows a stay of up to 90 days.

english_meaning: An official government document that certifies identity and citizenship for international travel.
gujarati_meaning: સરકારી ઓળખ દસ્તાવેજ — જે આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય મુસાફરી માટે નાગરિકત્વ સાબિત કરે છે.
usage_note: Must be valid for at least 6 months beyond the travel date in most countries.
memory_tip: Pass + port = બંદર (port) માંથી પસાર (pass) થવા માટે.
examples: Make sure your passport is valid before booking the trip.
He renewed his passport two months before travel.
Always keep your passport safe while traveling abroad.
The officer stamped her passport at the border.

english_meaning: A place where travelers can stay, such as a hotel, hostel, or guesthouse.
gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરો રહી શકે તેવી જગ્યા — જેમ કે હોટેલ, ધર્મશાળા અથવા ગેસ્ટ હાઉસ.
usage_note: British English uses 'accommodation' (uncountable); American English uses 'accommodations' (plural).
memory_tip: Accommodate = સગવડ આપવી → accommodation = રહેવાની સગવડ.
examples: We booked accommodation near the city centre.
The accommodation included breakfast.
Finding affordable accommodation in Paris was difficult.
The tour package includes flights and accommodation.

english_meaning: The amount of money planned to be spent on a trip or activity.
gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી પર ખર્ચ કરવા માટે નક્કી કરેલી રકમ.
usage_note: 'Budget travel' means traveling cheaply and economically.
memory_tip: Budget = બજેટ — ખર્ચની મર્યાદા. B = Boundary of money.
examples: We planned a 10-day trip with a budget of $2,000.
Budget airlines offer cheap flights with few extras.
She always travels on a tight budget.
The budget for food was $50 per day.

english_meaning: A company or person that organizes tours and travel packages for customers.
gujarati_meaning: ટૂર અને ટ્રાવેલ પેકેજ ગોઠવી આપતી કંપની અથવા વ્યક્તિ.
usage_note: Tour operators create packages; travel agents sell them — though the terms often overlap.
memory_tip: Operator = ચલાવનાર → tour operator = ટૂર ચલાવનાર.
examples: The tour operator arranged everything from flights to hotels.
We hired a local tour operator for the Amazon trip.
The tour operator offered a 10-day Europe package.
Always check reviews before booking with a tour operator.

english_meaning: A form of low-cost, independent travel, often carrying belongings in a backpack.
gujarati_meaning: ઓછા ખર્ચે સ્વતંત્ર મુસાફરી — જ્યારે બધો સામાન પીઠ પર બેગમાં લઈ ફરો.
usage_note: Popular among young travelers who prefer flexibility over comfort.
memory_tip: Back + packing = પીઠ પર સામાન ભરવો → backpacking.
examples: He spent six months backpacking through Southeast Asia.
Backpacking is a great way to meet other travelers.
She saved money by backpacking instead of taking tours.
Backpacking hostels are usually cheap and social.

english_meaning: A short trip or outing taken as part of a holiday, usually to a specific place of interest.
gujarati_meaning: રજા દરમ્યાન કોઈ ખાસ જગ્યા જોવા માટે કરાતી ટૂંકી સફર.
usage_note: Usually a day trip from a main base, often organized by a hotel or cruise ship.
memory_tip: Ex (out) + cursion (run) = બહાર દોડવું → ટૂંકી ફેરી.
examples: We booked a half-day excursion to the waterfall.
The cruise included shore excursions at each port.
The excursion to the vineyard was the highlight of the trip.
Our hotel arranged excursions to nearby attractions.

english_meaning: A stop at an intermediate point between the start and destination of a journey, especially for flights.
gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી દરમ્યાન ગંતવ્ય સ્થળ પર પહોંચતા પહેલાં વચ્ચે કરાતો વિરામ — ખાસ કરીને વિમાન મુસાફરી વખતે.
usage_note: A layover under 24 hours; a stopover is typically longer and may include leaving the airport.
memory_tip: Lay (stay) + over (a place) = વચ્ચે રોકાવું.
examples: We had a 5-hour layover in Frankfurt.
The layover gave us time to explore the airport.
A long layover can sometimes let you visit the city.
She booked a flight with no layover for a faster journey.

english_meaning: Traveling from place to place, not settled in one location.
gujarati_meaning: એક જગ્યાએ ન ટકીને ફરતા રહેવું — જે સ્થળ-સ્થળ ફરે છે.
usage_note: Often used to describe a lifestyle or profession rather than a single trip.
memory_tip: Itinerant vs itinerary — same root 'iter' (journey). Itinerant = always journeying.
examples: He led an itinerant life, moving between cities every few months.
The itinerant traders visited the village once a week.
She chose an itinerant career as a travel photographer.
Itinerant musicians travel from town to town performing.

english_meaning: A strong desire or impulse to travel and explore the world.
gujarati_meaning: દુનિયા ફરવાની અને નવી જગ્યાઓ શોધવાની તીવ્ર ઇચ્છા.
usage_note: A German loanword now common in English travel writing and social media.
memory_tip: Wander (ભટકવું) + lust (ઇચ્છા) = ભટકવાની ઇચ્છા = wanderlust.
examples: Her wanderlust took her to over 50 countries.
Social media can ignite wanderlust in people.
Wanderlust inspired him to quit his job and travel.
The travel blog captured the essence of wanderlust perfectly.

english_meaning: The place where someone is going or where something is being sent.
gujarati_meaning: જ્યાં જવાનું છે તે સ્થળ — મુસાફરીનો અંતિમ પડાવ.
usage_note: Can refer to any stop along a journey, not just the final stop.
memory_tip: Destine (નક્કી) → destination = નક્કી કરેલી જગ્યા.
examples: Paris is a top tourist destination.
What is your final destination?
She crossed off each destination from her bucket list.
The island became a popular honeymoon destination.

english_meaning: A journey undertaken by a group of people for a specific purpose, often exploration or research.
gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ખાસ ઉદ્દેશ — જેમ કે સંશોધન અથવા ખોજ — માટે લોકોના જૂથ દ્વારા કરાતી સફર.
usage_note: Implies a purposeful, often challenging journey rather than leisure travel.
memory_tip: Expedite (ઝડપ) → expedition = ઝડપ અને ઉદ્દેશ સાથેની સફર.
examples: The team organized an expedition to climb Everest.
A scientific expedition discovered new species in the rainforest.
The Antarctic expedition lasted six months.
He led an expedition to map the uncharted territory.

english_meaning: The process of converting one country's money into another country's money.
gujarati_meaning: એક દેશના પૈસાને બીજા દેશના ચલણમાં બદલવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
usage_note: Always check the exchange rate before converting large amounts of money.
memory_tip: Currency = ચલણ, Exchange = બદલવું → currency exchange = ચલણ બદલો.
examples: We found a currency exchange office near the airport.
The currency exchange rate was favourable that day.
Always compare rates before doing a currency exchange.
She lost money due to a poor currency exchange rate.

english_meaning: Insurance coverage that protects travelers against unexpected events like illness, cancellation, or lost luggage.
gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી દરમ્યાન બીમારી, રદ કરવું અથવા સામાન ખોવા જેવી ઘટનાઓ સામે રક્ષણ આપતી વીમા પૉલિસી.
usage_note: Strongly recommended for international travel; covers medical emergencies, flight cancellations, and lost luggage.
memory_tip: Insurance = વીમો → travel insurance = મુસાફરી વીમો — નુકસાન સામે સુરક્ષા.
examples: Always buy travel insurance before an international trip.
Her travel insurance covered the cost of the cancelled flight.
The travel insurance policy included emergency medical cover.
Without travel insurance, the hospital bills were enormous.

english_meaning: A temporary feeling of fatigue and disorientation caused by rapid long-distance travel across time zones.
gujarati_meaning: ઝડપી લાંબા-અંતર ટ્રાવેલ દ્વારા સમય ઝોન બદલાવ ના કારણે થતી થાક અને ગૂંચવણ.
usage_note: More severe when traveling east than west; drinking water and adjusting sleep helps.
memory_tip: Jet (વિમાન) + lag (પાછળ રહેવું) = ઘડિયાળ આગળ, શરીર પાછળ.
examples: She felt terrible jet lag after the 14-hour flight.
It took him three days to recover from jet lag.
Drinking water helps reduce the effects of jet lag.
Jet lag is worse when you fly from west to east.

english_meaning: The process of registering at an airport or hotel upon arrival.
gujarati_meaning: એરપોર્ટ અથવા હોટેલ પર પહોંચ્યા પછી નોંધણી કરાવવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
usage_note: Online check-in for flights typically opens 24–48 hours before departure.
memory_tip: Check = ચકાસવું + in = અંદર → check-in = અંદર જવા ચકાસણી.
examples: Please check in at least two hours before your flight.
The check-in counter closes 45 minutes before departure.
She completed the online check-in the night before.
Hotel check-in time is usually at 3 PM.

english_meaning: A document issued by an airline to confirm that a passenger has checked in and is allowed to board the plane.
gujarati_meaning: એરલાઇન દ્વારા અપાતો દસ્તાવેજ — જે સાબિત કરે છે કે પ્રવાસી ચેક-ઇન કરી ચૂક્યો છે અને વિમાનમાં ચઢી શકે છે.
usage_note: Now often available as a mobile boarding pass on smartphones.
memory_tip: Board (ચઢવું) + pass (પાસ) = વિમાનમાં ચઢવા મળેલો પાસ.
examples: Don't forget to print your boarding pass before the flight.
She showed her mobile boarding pass at the gate.
The boarding pass shows your seat number and gate.
He lost his boarding pass and had to get a new one.

english_meaning: The official department that controls goods brought into or taken out of a country and collects duties.
gujarati_meaning: સરકારી વિભાગ — જે દેશની અંદર અથવા બહાર જતી વસ્તુઓ પર નિયંત્રણ રાખે છે અને ડ્યૂટી વસૂલ કરે છે.
usage_note: You must declare expensive items or large amounts of cash at customs.
memory_tip: Custom = નિયમ/રીત → customs = દેશના નિયમ ચેક કરવાની જગ્યા.
examples: He declared his expensive camera at customs.
Going through customs took nearly an hour.
The customs officer asked her to open her bag.
You must pay customs duty on goods over the limit.

english_meaning: The process of checking passports and travel documents when entering a foreign country.
gujarati_meaning: વિદેશી દેશમાં પ્રવેશ કરતી વખતે પાસપોર્ટ અને દસ્તાવેજ ચકાસવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
usage_note: Immigration checks passport; customs checks baggage — they are different counters.
memory_tip: Immigrate = બીજા દેશમાં આવવું → immigration = આવવાની ચકાસણી.
examples: The immigration queue was very long after landing.
She filled in the immigration form on the plane.
The immigration officer stamped her passport.
Immigration control is strict in many countries.

english_meaning: The area in an airport where passengers wait before boarding their flight, after passing through security.
gujarati_meaning: સિક્યુરિટી પછી એરપોર્ટમાં જ્યાં પ્રવાસીઓ ફ્લાઇટ ચઢતા પહેલાં રાહ જુએ છે.
usage_note: The departure lounge is airside — after security, accessible only to passengers.
memory_tip: Depart (જવું) + lounge (આરામ ઓરડો) = જવા પહેલાં બેસવાની જગ્યા.
examples: We had two hours in the departure lounge before the flight.
The departure lounge had duty-free shops and restaurants.
She bought a book in the departure lounge.
The gate number is displayed in the departure lounge.

english_meaning: The area in an airport where passengers collect their checked luggage after a flight.
gujarati_meaning: ઉડ્ડયન પછી એરપોર્ટમાં જ્યાં પ્રવાસીઓ તેમનો ચેક-ઇન સામાન ઉઠાવે છે.
usage_note: Luggage arrives on a conveyor belt/carousel; keep your baggage tag to match with your bag.
memory_tip: Baggage = સામાન + claim = માગવું → baggage claim = સામાન માગો.
examples: We waited at baggage claim for 30 minutes.
His suitcase didn't appear at the baggage claim.
The baggage claim area was crowded after the long-haul flight.
Follow the signs to baggage claim after landing.

english_meaning: A storage space above passenger seats on an aircraft for carrying hand luggage.
gujarati_meaning: વિમાનમાં પ્રવાસીઓની સીટ ઉપર હાથ-સામાન રાખવા માટેની સ્ટોરેજ જગ્યા.
usage_note: Hand luggage must fit within airline size limits to go in the overhead compartment.
memory_tip: Over (ઉપર) + head (માથું) + compartment (ખાનું) = માથા ઉપરનું ખાનું.
examples: Please place your bag in the overhead compartment.
The overhead compartment was already full when he boarded.
She couldn't reach the overhead compartment without help.
Airlines charge fees if your bag doesn't fit the overhead compartment.

english_meaning: Irregular motion of air that causes a plane to shake or bump during flight.
gujarati_meaning: હવાની અનિયમિત ગતિ — જે ઉડ્ડયન દરમ્યાન વિમાનને હલાવી દે છે.
usage_note: Turbulence is rarely dangerous but can be uncomfortable; always keep seatbelt fastened.
memory_tip: Turbulent = ઉથલ-પુથલ → turbulence = વિમાનમાં ઉથલ-પુથલ.
examples: The flight hit severe turbulence over the mountains.
The pilot warned passengers about upcoming turbulence.
Mild turbulence made the drinks spill.
Despite the turbulence, they landed safely.

english_meaning: The process of passing through a country or airport on the way to your final destination.
gujarati_meaning: ગંતવ્ય સ્થળ પહોંચતા પહેલાં કોઈ દેશ અથવા એરપોર્ટ માંથી પસાર થવું.
usage_note: Some countries require a transit visa even if you don't leave the airport.
memory_tip: Transit = ટ્રાન્ઝિટ — વચ્ચે પસાર. Trans (across) + it = across it.
examples: We were in transit at Singapore for six hours.
Transit passengers must stay in the transit lounge.
She needed a transit visa to stop over in the UK.
He spent his transit time shopping at the duty-free.

english_meaning: A seat on a plane, train, or bus that is next to the walkway between rows of seats.
gujarati_meaning: વિમાન, ટ્રેન અથવા બસ પર પ્રવાસીઓ વચ્ચેની ગલીની બાજુ આવેલી સીટ.
usage_note: Preferred by tall passengers or those who frequently get up during flights.
memory_tip: Aisle = ગલી → aisle seat = ગલી બાજુ બેઠક.
examples: She always requests an aisle seat for long flights.
The aisle seat allows you to walk around more easily.
He was upgraded to an aisle seat with extra legroom.
Aisle seats are popular on overnight flights.

english_meaning: Bags or luggage that passengers are allowed to take onto the plane into the cabin.
gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસીઓ વિમાનના કેબિનમાં સાથે લઈ જઈ શકે તેવો સામાન.
usage_note: Must meet airline size and weight limits; liquids restricted to 100ml containers in a clear bag.
memory_tip: Carry (સાથે) + on (ઉપર) = સાથે ઉપર — વિમાનમાં સાથે.
examples: Her carry-on luggage fit perfectly in the overhead bin.
Always pack valuables in your carry-on luggage.
Budget airlines charge extra for carry-on luggage above the limit.
He managed the whole trip with just carry-on luggage.

english_meaning: Transportation by road or rail as opposed to by air, especially from an airport to a destination.
gujarati_meaning: હવાઈ નહીં પણ સડક અથવા રેલ દ્વારા પ્રવાસ — ખાસ કરીને એરપોર્ટથી ગંતવ્ય સ્થળ સુધી.
usage_note: Includes taxis, buses, trains, shuttles, and car rentals from the airport.
memory_tip: Ground = જમીન → ground transportation = જમીન-આધારિત વાહન-વ્યવહાર.
examples: The hotel provides ground transportation from the airport.
We used ground transportation to avoid expensive flights.
Ground transportation from the airport costs $30 by taxi.
The information desk listed all ground transportation options.

english_meaning: The specific numbered exit point in an airport from which passengers board their aircraft.
gujarati_meaning: એરપોર્ટમાં ચોક્કસ નંબર વાળો બહાર નીકળવાનો દ્વાર — જ્યાંથી પ્રવાસીઓ વિમાનમાં ચઢે છે.
usage_note: Gates can change, so always check the departure boards for updates.
memory_tip: Depart (જવું) + gate (દ્વાર) = ઉડ્ડયનનો દ્વાર.
examples: Please proceed to departure gate B12.
The departure gate was changed at the last minute.
Boarding begins at the departure gate 40 minutes before take-off.
She arrived at the departure gate just in time.

english_meaning: A vehicle that regularly transports people between two fixed points, such as an airport and a hotel.
gujarati_meaning: બે નિશ્ચિત સ્થળો વચ્ચે નિયમિત મુસાફર લઈ જતું વાહન — જેમ કે એરપોર્ટ અને હોટેલ.
usage_note: Free hotel shuttles to airports are common; check booking details for availability.
memory_tip: Shuttle = ઓળઘોળ ફરવું — back and forth like a shuttle in weaving.
examples: The hotel offers a free shuttle to the airport.
We took the shuttle from Terminal 1 to Terminal 2.
The shuttle runs every 20 minutes.
She missed the last shuttle and had to take a taxi.

english_meaning: A flight that requires a passenger to change planes at an intermediate airport to reach their final destination.
gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે ગંતવ્ય સ્થળ સુધી પહોંચવા માટે વચ્ચે એક એરપોર્ટ પર ઉતરી બીજા વિમાન પર ચઢવું પડે.
usage_note: Allow at least 90 minutes between flights to catch a connection comfortably.
memory_tip: Connect (જોડવું) + flight = એક ફ્લાઇટ પછી બીજી — જોડાયેલી ઉડ્ડયન.
examples: We had a connecting flight in Amsterdam.
He missed his connecting flight due to the delay.
The connecting flight was only an hour away.
Book direct flights to avoid the stress of connecting flights.

english_meaning: A long strip of ground at an airport on which aircraft take off and land.
gujarati_meaning: એરપોર્ટ પર લાંબી પટ્ટી — જ્યાં વિમાન ઉડે છે અને ઉતરે છે.
usage_note: Runways are numbered based on their magnetic direction (e.g., Runway 27 faces 270 degrees).
memory_tip: Run (દોડ) + way (રસ્તો) = વિમાન દોડે તે રસ્તો.
examples: The plane taxied to the runway before take-off.
Fog closed the runway for two hours.
There was a delay because another aircraft was on the runway.
Modern airports can have up to six runways.

english_meaning: The paved surface of an airport, including runways and areas where planes park.
gujarati_meaning: એરપોર્ટ પરની પાકી સપાટી — જ્યાં વિમાન ઊભા હોય અને રહે.
usage_note: 'Tarmac' is technically a brand name for tar-macadam; now used generically for airport pavement.
memory_tip: Tar + mac(adam) = ડામર રસ્તો → tarmac = ડામર ઢળેલી એરપોર્ટ સ્ટ્રીટ.
examples: The plane sat on the tarmac for an hour before taking off.
Passengers walked across the tarmac to board the small aircraft.
Tarmac delays can be frustrating for passengers.
The crew waved from the tarmac as the plane arrived.

english_meaning: A hotel employee who assists guests with reservations, directions, tickets, and other services.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ કર્મચારી — જે મહેમાનોને બુકિંગ, ટ્રીપ ગોઠવવા, ટ્રાન્સ્પોર્ટ અને અન્ય સેવાઓ આપે છે.
usage_note: In luxury hotels, the concierge can arrange almost anything — restaurant bookings, tours, and more.
memory_tip: French word. Con = together + cierge = candle (guide) → one who guides guests.
examples: The concierge arranged theatre tickets for us.
Ask the concierge for restaurant recommendations.
The concierge desk is in the hotel lobby.
A good concierge knows every restaurant in the city.

english_meaning: Features or facilities that provide comfort, convenience, or enjoyment, especially in a hotel.
gujarati_meaning: સગવડ, આરામ અને આનંદ પૂરો પાડતી સુવિધાઓ — ખાસ કરીને હોટેલમાં.
usage_note: Hotel amenities can include pool, gym, Wi-Fi, restaurant, spa, and toiletries.
memory_tip: Ameni (pleasant) + ties = pleasantries → amenities = pleasant extras.
examples: The hotel has excellent amenities including a spa and pool.
In-room amenities included a minibar and free Wi-Fi.
The room amenities were better than expected.
The hostel had basic amenities but a great location.

english_meaning: A set of connected rooms in a hotel, larger and more luxurious than a standard room.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ પર જોડાયેલા ઓરડાઓનો સમૂહ — સ્ટાન્ડર્ડ રૂમ કરતા મોટો અને વૈભવી.
usage_note: Suites usually include a separate bedroom, living area, and sometimes a kitchen.
memory_tip: Suite sounds like 'sweet' — a sweet (great) room!
examples: They stayed in the honeymoon suite for their anniversary.
The presidential suite had a private pool and a butler.
We upgraded to a junior suite for the extra space.
The suite overlooked the ocean — it was breathtaking.

english_meaning: The department in a hotel responsible for cleaning rooms and maintaining general tidiness.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ વિભાગ — જે ઓરડા સાફ કરવા અને સ્વચ્છ રાખવા માટે જવાબદાર છે.
usage_note: Use the 'Do Not Disturb' sign to prevent housekeeping from entering your room.
memory_tip: House + keeping = ઘર (ઓરડો) સ્વચ્છ રાખવું.
examples: Please call housekeeping for extra towels.
Housekeeping cleaned the room while we were at breakfast.
She left a tip for the housekeeping staff.
The housekeeping cart blocked the hallway.

english_meaning: An arrangement allowing guests to leave their hotel room after the standard check-out time.
gujarati_meaning: નિર્ધારિત ચેક-આઉટ સમય પછી ઓરડો છોડવાની સ્વીકૃત વ્યવસ્થા.
usage_note: Late check-out is usually available for an extra fee or for loyalty program members.
memory_tip: Late = મોડું + check-out = ઓરડો છોડવો → late check-out = મોડું ઓરડો છોડવો.
examples: She requested a late check-out as her flight was in the evening.
The hotel allowed late check-out until 2 PM.
Late check-out cost an extra $30.
Loyalty members often get free late check-out.

english_meaning: A small refrigerator in a hotel room stocked with drinks and snacks for purchase by guests.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ ઓરડામાં નાનો ફ્રીઝ — જ્યાં ઠંડા પીણા અને ખાવાની ચીજો ચૂકવીને મળે.
usage_note: Minibar items are expensive; check the price list before consuming anything.
memory_tip: Mini (નાનો) + bar (બાર/દારૂ) = ઓરડામાં નાનો બાર.
examples: She helped herself to a water from the minibar.
The minibar was restocked every day.
Minibar charges added $40 to the hotel bill.
He didn't touch the minibar to save money.

english_meaning: A service in hotels that allows guests to order food and drinks directly to their room.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ સેવા — જ્યાં મહેમાનો ઓરડામાં બેઠા ખોરાક અને પીણા મંગાવી શકે.
usage_note: Room service is convenient but usually includes a service charge and delivery fee.
memory_tip: Room (ઓરડો) + service (સેવા) = ઓરડામાં ખોરાક સેવા.
examples: They ordered room service after the long flight.
The room service menu had over 30 dishes.
24-hour room service is available in this hotel.
Room service added a 15% surcharge to the bill.

english_meaning: Given free of charge as a courtesy or bonus, especially in hotels.
gujarati_meaning: ભેટ અથવા વિવેક ખાતર મફત આપવામાં આવેલ — ખાસ કરીને હોટેલ માં.
usage_note: 'Complimentary' means free; don't confuse with 'complementary' (which means completing/combining well).
memory_tip: Compliment (વખાણ) → complimentary = વખાણ ખાતર ભેટ — free!
examples: Breakfast is complimentary for all guests.
We received a complimentary room upgrade.
The hotel provided complimentary toiletries.
Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in the lobby.

english_meaning: An available or unoccupied room in a hotel.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ માં ખાલી ઉપલબ્ধ ઓરડો.
usage_note: A 'No Vacancy' sign means the hotel is fully booked.
memory_tip: Vacant = ખાલી → vacancy = ખાલી ઓરડો.
examples: The hotel had no vacancy during the festival.
We drove around looking for a vacancy sign.
There are a few vacancies for the long weekend.
Please check online for current vacancies.

english_meaning: A budget accommodation where travelers sleep in shared dormitory rooms.
gujarati_meaning: સસ્તી રહેઠાણ જ્યાં મુસાફરો ભેળી ભૂળ ડૉર્મ ઓરડામાં સૂઈ શકે.
usage_note: Hostels often have shared bathrooms; great for meeting other travelers.
memory_tip: Hostel vs Hotel — Hostel has 'S' for Shared. Hotel is private.
examples: She stayed in a hostel to save money.
The hostel had a shared kitchen and lounge.
Youth hostels are popular among backpackers.
He met his travel friends at the hostel.

english_meaning: A small guesthouse offering overnight accommodation with breakfast included in the price.
gujarati_meaning: નાનું ગેસ્ટ હાઉસ — જ્યાં રહેવા-જમવા (સવારના) ની ભેળી સુવિધા મળે.
usage_note: B&Bs are often family-run and offer a more personal experience than hotels.
memory_tip: Bed (સૂવાનો) + Breakfast (સવારનો નાસ્તો) = બે ઇ ભેળા.
examples: They stayed at a charming bed and breakfast in the Cotswolds.
The B&B served a full English breakfast every morning.
A bed and breakfast is often cheaper than a hotel.
The owners of the B&B treated us like family.

english_meaning: A bedroom with a private bathroom directly connected to it.
gujarati_meaning: ઓરડો — જ્યાં સ્નાનઘર સીધો ઓરડા સાથે જ જોડેલ હોય.
usage_note: French phrase meaning 'in sequence'; in travel, means attached private bathroom.
memory_tip: French 'en suite' = in a series/set → room and bathroom together.
examples: We booked an en suite room for more privacy.
The en suite bathroom had a bath and a separate shower.
Most modern hotels offer en suite rooms.
The hostel had shared bathrooms, not en suite.

english_meaning: An evening hotel service where staff prepare the room for sleep, usually including folding back the bedcovers and leaving chocolates or mints.
gujarati_meaning: સાંજની હોટેল સેવા — જ્યાં સ્ટાફ ઓરડો ઊંઘ માટે તૈયાર કરે છે, ચાદર ઉઘાડે છે અને ચૉકલેટ મૂકે છે.
usage_note: Common in four and five-star hotels; may include dimming lights, soft music, and mints on the pillow.
memory_tip: Turn down = ઉઘાડવું → turndown service = ઊંઘ માટે ઓરડો ખોલવાની સેવા.
examples: The turndown service included chocolates on the pillow.
We requested the turndown service every night.
Five-star hotels pride themselves on their turndown service.
She loved coming back to a turned-down room.

english_meaning: The process of settling the bill and handing back the room key when leaving a hotel.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ છોડ્યા સમયે હિસાબ ચૂકવવો અને ઓરડાની ચાવી પાછી આપવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
usage_note: Standard hotel checkout time is 11 AM or 12 noon; ask for late checkout if needed.
memory_tip: Check (ચૂકવો) + out (બહાર) = ચૂકવ્યા પછી બહાર.
examples: Checkout is at 11 AM in this hotel.
He completed the express checkout to save time.
Please return your key card at checkout.
They checked out early to catch the morning train.

english_meaning: A luxurious apartment or suite on the top floor of a hotel or building.
gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ અથવા ઇમારતના ટોચ માળ પર વૈભવી ઓરડો અથવા ફ્લેટ.
usage_note: Penthouses usually command premium prices for the views and exclusive amenities.
memory_tip: Pent (top/roof) + house = ટોચ પરનું ઘર.
examples: They stayed in the penthouse suite for a special occasion.
The penthouse had a private rooftop terrace.
A night in the penthouse costs over $2,000.
The penthouse suite offered a 360-degree view of the city.

english_meaning: The friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests, as a practice or as an industry.
gujarati_meaning: મહેમાનોને ઉષ્માભર્યો આવકાર આપવો — મહેમાનગતિ; અથવા હોટેલ-ટ્રાવેલ ઉદ્યોગ.
usage_note: In business contexts, 'hospitality' refers to the hotel, restaurant, and tourism industry.
memory_tip: Hospital + ity → both care for people → hospitality = guests ને care.
examples: The locals showed great hospitality to tourists.
She worked in the hospitality industry for 10 years.
The hotel's hospitality was second to none.
Indian hospitality is famous around the world.
